verdict.rationale: WorkOS/AuthKit is documented as a 'full-fledged authentication platform' with 'customizable hosted UI for authentication at any size' covering SSO, passkeys, social sign-in, passwords, and magic auth, plus APIs to 'store additional information about users and organizations' for profile management, and community testimonials confirm ease of adopting its SSO/SCIM UI wrappers in production apps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prebuilt embeddable UI *components* (vs. only hosted pages) for profile management specifically, and independent hands-on verification of UI customization depth beyond vendor docs.
